title: The twin prime conjecture
summary: There are infinitely many primes $p$ with $p + 2$ prime. Hardy and Littlewood conjectured the count up to $x$ is about $2C_2\,x/(\log x)^2$ with $C_2 \approx 0.6602$. Bounded gaps (246) is the best unconditional result.

title: Goldbach's conjecture
summary: Every even integer greater than $2$ is a sum of two primes (Goldbach to Euler, 1742). Verified by computer far beyond $10^{18}$; the ternary version was proved by Helfgott in 2013.

title: The Riemann hypothesis
summary: Every nontrivial zero of $\zeta$ has real part $\tfrac12$. Stated by Riemann in 1859, one of Hilbert's 1900 problems and a Clay Millennium Problem since 2000. Open as of October 2026.

prerequisites.title: Nontrivial zeros and the Riemann–von Mangoldt formula

research_problems.title: Millennium Prize · The Riemann hypothesis
research_problems.statement: Prove that every non-trivial zero of the Riemann zeta function $\zeta(s)$ has real part $\tfrac12$.
